# `snaidhm.font`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from snaidhm/src/font.almd; do not edit. -->

_TrueType parsing and glyph rasterising._

TrueType font reading and glyph rasterisation, in Almide.

Reads the tables a UI needs (head, hhea, maxp, cmap 4/12, hmtx, loca,
glyf — simple and composite glyphs) straight from the font's bytes and
rasterises outlines with signed-area coverage accumulation (the font-rs
method): every line segment adds its exact area contribution to the cells
it crosses, and a running sum per row yields anti-aliased coverage.

```almide
import snaidhm.font
```

```almide
type Font = {

  ok: Bool,
  units_per_em: Float,
  ascender: Float,
  descender: Float,
  line_gap: Float,
  num_glyphs: Int,
  num_hmetrics: Int,
  index_to_loc: Int,
  cmap4: Int,
  cmap12: Int,
  loca: Int,
  glyf: Int,
  hmtx: Int,
}
```

### `empty_font`

```almide
pub fn empty_font() -> Font
```


How far the pen moves after glyph `gid`, in font units.

## Outlines

### `Outline`

```almide
type Outline = { xs: List[Float], ys: List[Float], on: List[Bool], ends: List[Int] }
```

A glyph outline in font units: points with on-curve flags, and the index
one past the last point of each contour.

### `outline`

```almide
pub fn outline(f: Font, gid: Int) -> Outline
```

Glyph `gid`'s outline (composite glyphs flattened).

## Rasterisation

```almide
type Bitmap = { w: Int, h: Int, left: Int, top: Int, pixels: Bytes }
```

### `rasterize`

```almide
pub fn rasterize(f: Font, gid: Int, size_px: Float) -> Bitmap
```

Rasterise glyph `gid` at `size_px` pixels per em. `left`/`top` place the
bitmap relative to the pen position on the baseline (top is distance above
the baseline). Pixels are 8-bit coverage, row-major, w*h.
